visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a mustache, wearing a gray blazer over a white t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit studio with white shelves. He holds a black and a pink beauty device, gesturing towards the camera with an excited expression. (2) The scene cuts to extreme close-ups of the man's eyes and cheek, showing skin texture changes marked by white arrows. Large white text overlays cover the center of the frame. (3) Back in the studio, the man continues to hold the pink device, pointing and talking animatedly. A small clip of him wearing a headband and a sheet mask while using the device is shown in the corner. (4) Close-up shots of two beauty devices (black and pink) appear, showing their metallic heads and circular light displays. The background is a clean, minimalist studio setting with soft lighting. (5) A split-screen or collage shows the man using the device in four different modes, each associated with a specific LED color: red, green, blue, and pink. He moves the device across his forehead, cheeks, and jawline. (6) Detailed demonstration of the 'Booster' mode begins; the man applies a liquid serum to his cheek using a glass dropper and then massages the area with the device. A technical animation of skin layers and absorption appears. (7) The demonstration shifts to 'MC' mode with a green light; the man talks while a woman is shown using the device on her cheek and around her eyes. (8) Transition to 'Derma-S' mode with a pink light; the man uses the device along his jawline to show a lifting effect. He playfully 'throws' a Photoshop icon away. (9) 'Air Shot' mode is shown with a blue light; a woman uses the device on her cheek while a cross-section diagram of skin pores appears. (10) The man demonstrates the device's connectivity to a smartphone app, showing various LED color selection screens. (11) A Montage shows the man looking tired with a headband, then appearing refreshed and 'charged' while holding the devices. He uses the black device over a white sheet mask. (12) Footage shows a female celebrity (Kim Hee-sun) holding the device, followed by industrial clips of factory robots assembling the products in a cleanroom environment. (13) Final scene returns to the man in the studio, holding the pink device and giving an enthusiastic recommendation with heart emojis appearing around him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched energetic male voice exclaims with a rising intonation over a fast-paced electronic synth BGM. A sharp 'whoosh' transition effect occurs between phrases. (2) The narration becomes more informative as the speaker describes skin aging; a 'ding' sound effect highlights the appearance of text overlays. The BGM maintains a steady, driving percussive beat. (3) A sequence of digital 'blip' and 'click' sound effects triggers as the speaker lists different device modes. The voice remains high-arousal and authoritative. (4) During the detailed mode breakdown, subtle liquid 'splash' or 'pop' sounds are added as the speaker mentions serum absorption. The BGM swells slightly in frequency brightness. (5) As the speaker transitions to the app demonstration, a digital UI 'beep' sound is heard. The vocal delivery speed increases slightly to match the rapid visual cuts. (6) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic call to action; the speaker's voice reaches a peak intensity, followed by a 'ting' sparkle sound effect as the heart graphics appear.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Technical Demonstration -> Social Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To market and sell the Medicube AGE-R Booster Pro by highlighting its four distinct skincare modes and demonstrating superior absorption results compared to manual application.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of product features, brand logo visibility, and a specific call to action to buy through a link.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density text overlays and rapid editing typical of social commerce advertisements to maintain viewer engagement. The production quality is high, featuring clean studio shots and technical 3D animations of skin.
